debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis regime, inverted yield curve, post-FOMC environment, DXY headwind), zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, no smart money alignment, high earnings risk in 91 days), overbought RSI with weak trend confirmation (ADX false, CMF distribution pressure), and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create severe structural resistance to upside.
